newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Canberra allows Medibank health premium rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Canberra allows Medibank health premium rise.

text.p: Australian private health insurer Medibank Private said on Wednesday the government had approved an increase in its health premiums of 12.9 percent on average across Australia.
Acting managing director Michael Parsons said the premium increases were necessary to offset the higher benefits being paid to the fund's members.
"The new premiums are highly competitive and the decision to move was only taken after every possible means of holding our rates had been examined," Parsons said in a statement.
"This is the first increase we have made after holding premiums for 19 months or more in most states."
Earlier on Wednesday, Medical Benefits Fund of Australia (MBF) said the government had approved an estimated rise in its premium rates of 6.5 percent nationally for its members.

In its August 20 budget, the Liberal-National government announced tax incentives worth A$500 million a year to encourage people to take out private health insurance and to wean wealthier people off the public Medicare health system.
